tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background — about 70% of any layout. Dark: the brand ground #161826. Light: neutral-100.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, dialogs, the logo tile — about 18% of a layout. Sits directly on ground; no third surface level.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on ground and surface (dark 14.5:1 / 12.6:1; light 13.4:1 / 11.5:1). Never pure white or black.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, hints, metadata, table headers — on ground and surface (dark ≥7.5:1; light ≥5.3:1). The brand sheet lists muted-light as #75798c (neutral-600); that measures 3.9:1 on the light ground, so small muted text in the light theme steps down to neutral-700 and 600 is kept for icons, borders and text 24px+.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one accent: outlines, the logo point, icons that mark state, focus rings, large type. About 3% of a layout — a line, a point or a glow, never a flood. Light theme maps to accent-600.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent as text at UI size: primary and ghost button labels, the current nav item, selected tab. Dark 5.4:1 on ground, 4.7:1 on surface; light uses accent-700 (6.2:1 / 5.5:1) because accent-600 only reaches 4.1:1.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links inside paragraphs and kickers (the 11px caps label above a heading). Brand rule: paragraph-size accent text is accent-300 on dark, accent-700 on light. Always underlined in running text.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Accent-tinted fills: hover/selected rows, the accent logo tile, avatar grounds. Text on it is accent-tint-ink.

tokens.name: accent-tint-strong
tokens.usage: Accent tag fill.

tokens.name: accent-tint-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent-tint and accent-tint-strong (≥8:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: tag-neutral
tokens.usage: Neutral tag fill.

tokens.name: tag-neutral-ink
tokens.usage: Text on tag-neutral (≥9:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Marks on a solid accent fill — the checkbox tick, the switch knob. Solid accent fills are limited to those small controls.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Hairlines between content: rules (faded at both ends), table rows, secondary button and segmented-control outlines. Decorative only — not for control boundaries.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Boundaries of inputs, selects, checkboxes, radios and switches — ≥3.5:1 on ground and surface in both themes. Intentional addition: the source used the 16% divider here, which is too faint to find a field by.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid 2px outline at 2px offset (≥3.5:1 on every surface). Never the browser default.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: ::selection highlight.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind dialogs.

tokens.name: logo-tile
tokens.usage: The logo tile fill. Light grounds take neutral-100 with a neutral-300 hairline (shadow-sm).

tokens.name: logo-plate
tokens.usage: The three plates of the monogram.

tokens.name: logo-point
tokens.usage: The point under the F — the accent's only appearance in the mark.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons, on ground, surface and success-tint (≥4.5:1 in both themes). Always paired with an icon and a word — never colour alone.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Background of success alerts and tags.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons, on ground, surface and warning-tint (≥4.5:1 in both themes). Always paired with an icon and a word — never colour alone.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Background of warning alerts and tags.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Danger text and icons, on ground, surface and danger-tint (≥4.5:1 in both themes). Always paired with an icon and a word — never colour alone.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Background of danger alerts and tags.

tokens.name: section
tokens.usage: Saturated deep-indigo ground for ONE full-bleed band per page (a stat band, a deck divider) — saturation as presence. Text on it is text (11:1). Never an interface colour.

tokens.name: section-glow
tokens.usage: The lighter bloom inside a section band (radial, top-left).

tokens.name: neutral-100
tokens.usage: Light ground; text on dark tints.

tokens.name: neutral-200
tokens.usage: Light surface.

tokens.name: neutral-300
tokens.usage: Light hairlines and the light logo-tile edge.

tokens.name: neutral-400
tokens.usage: Muted text on dark grounds.

tokens.name: neutral-500
tokens.usage: Mid grey — placeholder text on dark.

tokens.name: neutral-600
tokens.usage: Control borders in both themes; icons and 24px+ muted text on light.

tokens.name: neutral-700
tokens.usage: Muted text on light; dark-theme medium-elevation edge.

tokens.name: neutral-800
tokens.usage: Dark-theme low-elevation edge; neutral tag fill.

tokens.name: neutral-900
tokens.usage: Light-theme text.

tokens.name: accent-100
tokens.usage: Text on accent-800/900 fills.

tokens.name: accent-200
tokens.usage: Light accent tint; plates on the accent logo tile.

tokens.name: accent-300
tokens.usage: Paragraph-size accent text and kickers on dark; the accent-tile point.

tokens.name: accent-400
tokens.usage: Pressed/hover accent on dark grounds.

tokens.name: accent-500
tokens.usage: Ramp base (the brand accent #9184d9 sits just under it).

tokens.name: accent-600
tokens.usage: The accent on light grounds (lines, icons, 24px+ text).

tokens.name: accent-700
tokens.usage: Accent text on light grounds; dashed guides on dark.

tokens.name: accent-800
tokens.usage: Accent tag fill on dark.

tokens.name: accent-900
tokens.usage: Accent tint on dark; the accent logo tile.

groups.name: Headings
groups.note: Inter 500 only. Hierarchy is size and space — never bolder than 500, never italic.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page at most: a landing hero or an app's empty first screen.

styles.name: h4
styles.usage: Dialog title, group heading inside a page.

styles.name: h5
styles.usage: Minor heading within dense app UI.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Inter 400 for everything that is not a heading; 500 only for UI labels.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Fromnowhere builds small, careful software: apps, sites and community tools on one shared platform.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Card bodies, helper text, dense tables.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Button labels, nav links, segmented options (input text is the same size at 400).

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Photo — the Saturday locals, round three
styles.usage: Figure captions, card meta rows, in text-muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase (text-transform) table headers and small labels, text-muted.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Uppercase line above a section heading, in link colour. Numbered "01 · Name" on long pages.

groups.name: Code
groups.note: System monospace — the identity names no mono face.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline code and code blocks; hex values and IDs in tables.

spacing.note: The brand's 4-8-12-16-24-32 steps at 0.7× density — compact on purpose. Two larger steps lay out pages.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: caption under a figure, tight icon pairs.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside controls (button vertical padding), between a heading and its paragraph.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding, paragraph spacing, gap between form rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Nav padding, dialog padding, gap between cards in a dense grid.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between grouped panels; text block inset.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutter, panel padding, gap inside a hero.

tokens.name: space-section
tokens.usage: Between page sections and as hero padding on marketing and community pages.

tokens.name: space-page
tokens.usage: Bottom padding of a long page; top of a landing hero on wide screens.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Swatches, inline code, checkboxes, the clear-space guide.

tokens.name: radius-tag
tokens.usage: Tags (0.75 × radius-md).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, cards, segmented controls, tables in a frame.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, panels, heroes, square avatars.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: The logo tile only (0.18 × tile size).

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Circular avatars, radios, the switch knob.

shadow.note: On dark, elevation is an edge plus ambient darkness; on light, a hairline plus a soft ink shadow. Never stack more than one.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting panels and tiles: a hairline edge.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, cards that lift on hover.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs — the top elevation.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Height of inputs, selects, icon buttons.

tokens.name: size-icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside buttons, tags and dense rows.

tokens.name: size-icon-md
tokens.usage: Default interface icon.

tokens.name: size-icon-lg
tokens.usage: Nav and toolbar icons.

tokens.name: size-icon-xl
tokens.usage: Marketing feature icons.

tokens.name: size-mark-min
tokens.usage: Smallest tiled logo on screen (6 mm in print); below it use the untiled mono mark.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls.

duration.note: Short and precise. Exits use the next step down, or happen instantly.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press, colour and border changes; every exit.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Control state changes: switch knob, checkbox tick, tab underline, segmented selection.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Things entering the screen: dialogs, alerts, menus, scroll reveals.

tokens.name: duration-slower
tokens.usage: Once-per-page moments only: the logo assembling, a hero settling in, a rule drawing across.

tokens.name: duration-stagger
tokens.usage: Delay between siblings in a staggered reveal. Stagger at most 6 items; the rest arrive with the sixth.

tokens.name: duration-loop
tokens.usage: One cycle of the Loader — the only looping motion in the system.

easing.note: Every curve decelerates into rest. No bounce, no overshoot, no springs.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: State changes on screen: hovers, toggles, underlines.

tokens.name: ease-enter
tokens.usage: Elements arriving: dialogs, alerts, reveals. Fast start, soft landing.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Elements leaving, with duration-fast.

tokens.name: ease-settle
tokens.usage: The brand curve: plates settling into place with a long, quiet tail. Logo assemble, rule draw, checkbox tick.

tokens.name: ease-linear
tokens.usage: Loops and progress only.

distance.note: Things travel a short way — they settle, they never fly in.

tokens.name: distance-sm
tokens.usage: Dialogs, menus and alerts lifting into place.

tokens.name: distance-md
tokens.usage: Scroll reveals and hero copy.

tokens.name: distance-lg
tokens.usage: The largest travel allowed — a full-width section entering. Never more.
